+def format_plain(findings: list[dict], sources: dict[str, str], *, show_urls: bool = True) -> str:
+    """Render compact cargo-style diagnostics for plain output."""
+    if not findings:
+        return "No findings to report. Good job!\n"
+    lines_out: list[str] = []
+    for item in findings:
+        ident, desc = item.get("ident", ""), item.get("desc", "")
+        det = item.get("determinations", {})
+        severity = str(det.get("severity", "Medium"))
+        level = {"High": "error", "Medium": "warning", "Low": "help",
+                 "Informational": "info"}.get(severity, "warning")
+        lines_out.append(f"{level}[{ident}]: {desc}")
+        locations = item.get("locations", [])
+        for idx, loc in enumerate(locations):
+            sym = loc.get("symbolic", {})
+            concrete = loc.get("concrete", {})
+            key = sym.get("key", {})
+            local = key.get("Local", {})
+            path = local.get("given_path", "<stdin>" if "Stdin" in key else "")
+            point = concrete.get("location", {})
+            start, end = point.get("start_point", {}), point.get("end_point", {})
+            row, col = start.get("row", 0), start.get("column", 0)
+            feature = concrete.get("feature", "")
+            source = sources.get(path, "")
+            source_lines = source.splitlines()
+            lines_out.append(f" --> {path}:{row + 1}:{col + 1}")
+            lines_out.append("  |")
+            if source_lines and row < len(source_lines):
+                first_row = row
+                last_row = min(end.get("row", row), len(source_lines) - 1)
+                width = len(str(last_row + 1))
+                for line_no in range(first_row, last_row + 1):
+                    source_line = source_lines[line_no]
+                    lines_out.append(f"{line_no + 1:>{width}} | {source_line}")
+                    if line_no == first_row and line_no == last_row:
+                        length = max(1, end.get("column", col + 1) - col)
+                        marker = " " * col + "^" * length
+                        annotation = sym.get("annotation", "")
+                        lines_out.append(f"{'':>{width}} | {marker} {annotation}".rstrip())
+            elif feature:
+                lines_out.append(f"{row + 1} | {feature.rstrip()}")
+                lines_out.append(f"  | {' ' * col}^{' ' + sym.get('annotation', '')}")
+            lines_out.append("  |")
+        lines_out.append(f"  = note: audit confidence → {det.get('confidence', 'High')}")
+        if ident in ("artipacked", "template-injection", "dangerous-triggers"):
+            lines_out.append("  = note: this finding has an auto-fix")
+        if show_urls:
+            lines_out.append(f"  = help: audit documentation → {item.get('url', '')}")
+        lines_out.append("")
+    counts = {k: sum(str(f.get("determinations", {}).get("severity", "")).lower() == k
+                     for f in findings) for k in ("informational", "low", "medium", "high")}
+    lines_out.append(f"{len(findings)} findings: {counts['informational']} informational, "
+                     f"{counts['low']} low, {counts['medium']} medium, {counts['high']} high")
+    return "\n".join(lines_out) + "\n"
*** End Patch";

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small standard-library CLI for offline GitHub Actions workflow auditing."""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from audit_permissions import audit_excessive_permissions
from audit_insecure_commands import audit as audit_insecure_commands
from audits_uses import audit_uses
from bot_conditions import audit_bot_conditions
from anonymous_definition import audit_anonymous_definition
from audit_dangerous_triggers import audit_dangerous_triggers
from audit_artipacked import audit_artipacked
from audit_template_injection import audit_template_injection
from output_format import format_github, format_sarif

VERSION = "1.25.2"


def collect(inputs, kinds, strict=False):
    items = []
    for given in inputs:
        if given == "-":
            text = sys.stdin.read()
            if not text.strip():
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?m)^version\s*:\s*2\s*$", text) and re.search(r"(?m)^updates\s*:", text):
                typ = "dependabot"
            elif re.search(r"(?m)^runs\s*:", text):
                typ = "actions"
            elif re.search(r"(?m)^jobs\s*:", text):
                typ = "workflows"
            else:
                continue
            if typ in kinds or "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds:
                items.append(("<stdin>", text, typ))
            continue
        p = Path(given)
        if p.is_dir():
            if "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds or "workflows" in kinds:
                wf = p / ".github" / "workflows"
                if wf.is_dir():
                    items.extend((str(f), f.read_text(errors="replace"), "workflows")
                                 for f in sorted(wf.rglob("*.yml")) + sorted(wf.rglob("*.yaml")))
            if "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds or "actions" in kinds:
                for pat in ("action.yml", "action.yaml"):
                    items.extend((str(f), f.read_text(errors="replace"), "actions")
                                 for f in sorted(p.rglob(pat)))
            if "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds or "dependabot" in kinds:
                for f in (p / ".github" / "dependabot.yml", p / ".github" / "dependabot.yaml"):
                    if f.is_file():
                        items.append((str(f), f.read_text(errors="replace"), "dependabot"))
            continue
        if not p.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(given)
        text = p.read_text(errors="replace")
        typ = "dependabot" if "dependabot" in p.name.lower() else "actions" if p.name.startswith("action.") else "workflows"
        # Match collection's useful minimum schema check, preventing arbitrary
        # YAML and empty files from being treated as valid inputs.
        if not (re.search(r"(?m)^jobs\s*:", text) or
                re.search(r"(?m)^runs\s*:", text) or
                (re.search(r"(?m)^version\s*:\s*2\s*$", text) and
                 re.search(r"(?m)^updates\s*:", text))):
            if strict:
                raise ValueError(f"invalid input: {given}")
            print(f" WARN collect_inputs: failed to validate {given} as input", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        items.append((str(p), text, typ))
    return items


def parse_unpinned_policies(config_path):
    """Read the small mapping used by rules.unpinned-uses.config.policies."""
    if not config_path:
        return None
    try:
        lines = Path(config_path).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return None
    rules = next(((i, 0) for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^rules\s*:", line)), None)
    if rules is None:
        return None
    rules_i, rules_indent = rules
    def nested(parent_i, parent_indent, name):
        for j in range(parent_i + 1, len(lines)):
            if not lines[j].strip() or lines[j].lstrip().startswith("#"):
                continue
            m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([^:#]+)\s*:", lines[j])
            if m and len(m.group(1)) <= parent_indent:
                break
            if m and len(m.group(1)) > parent_indent and m.group(2).strip("'\"") == name:
                return j, len(m.group(1))
        return None
    audit = nested(rules_i, rules_indent, "unpinned-uses")
    if audit is None:
        return None
    cfg = nested(audit[0], audit[1], "config")
    if cfg is None:
        return None
    pol = nested(cfg[0], cfg[1], "policies")
    if pol is None:
        return None
    result = {}
    _, indent = pol
    for line in lines[pol[0] + 1:]:
        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            continue
        m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([^:#]+)\s*:\s*([^#]+)", line)
        if not m or len(m.group(1)) <= indent:
            break
        result[m.group(2).strip().strip("'\"")] = m.group(3).strip().strip("'\"")
    return result or None


def audit_file(path, text, persona, policies=None):
    findings = []
    # The available rules apply primarily to workflow and action YAML.
    findings += audit_artipacked(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_template_injection(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_uses(text, path, persona.capitalize(), policies)
    findings += audit_dangerous_triggers(text, path, persona)
    findings += audit_insecure_commands(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_bot_conditions(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_excessive_permissions(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    if persona in ("pedantic", "auditor"):
        findings += audit_anonymous_definition(text, path, persona)
    return findings


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="zizmor", description="Static analysis for GitHub Actions")
    ap.add_argument("inputs", nargs="*")
    ap.add_argument("--collect", action="append", default=[])
    ap.add_argument("--strict-collection", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--fix", nargs="?", const="safe", choices=["safe", "unsafe-only", "all"])
    ap.add_argument("-p", "--pedantic", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--persona", choices=["auditor", "pedantic", "regular"], default="regular")
    ap.add_argument("--min-severity", choices=["informational", "low", "medium", "high"])
    ap.add_argument("--min-confidence", choices=["low", "medium", "high"])
    ap.add_argument("--no-ignores", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="count", default=0)
    ap.add_argument("-q", "--quiet", action="count", default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--format", choices=["plain", "json", "json-v1", "sarif", "github"], default="plain")
    ap.add_argument("--no-progress", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--color", choices=["auto", "always", "never"], default="auto")
    ap.add_argument("--render-links", choices=["auto", "always", "never"], default="auto")
    ap.add_argument("--show-audit-urls", choices=["auto", "always", "never"], default="auto")
    ap.add_argument("--no-exit-codes", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-o", "--offline", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--gh-token")
    ap.add_argument("--gh-hostname", default="github.com")
    ap.add_argument("--no-online-audits", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cache-dir")
    ap.add_argument("--lsp", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-c", "--config")
    ap.add_argument("--no-config", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--completions", choices=["bash", "elvish", "fish", "nushell", "powershell", "zsh"])
    ap.add_argument("--thanks", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-V", "--version", action="version", version=f"zizmor {VERSION}")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if args.completions:
        return 0
    if not args.inputs:
        ap.error("the following arguments are required: <INPUT>...")
    if "-" in args.inputs and len(args.inputs) > 1:
        ap.error("`-` cannot be combined with other inputs")
    persona = "pedantic" if args.pedantic else args.persona
    kinds = {v for g in args.collect for v in re.split(r"[, ]+", g) if v}
    if not kinds:
        kinds = {"default"}
    try:
        files = collect(args.inputs, kinds, args.strict_collection)
    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as e:
        print(f"error: input not found: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if not files:
        print("fatal: no audit was performed\nerror: no inputs collected\n  |\n  = help: collection yielded no auditable inputs\n  = help: inputs must contain at least one valid workflow, action, or Dependabot config\n\nCaused by:\n    no inputs collected", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    config_file = None if args.no_config else (args.config or os.environ.get("ZIZMOR_CONFIG"))
    policies = parse_unpinned_policies(config_file)
    results = []
    for path, text, typ in files:
        if typ == "dependabot":
            continue
        current = audit_file(path, text, persona, policies)
        if path == "<stdin>":
            for result in current:
                for location in result.get("locations", []):
                    key = location.get("symbolic", {}).get("key", {})
                    if "Local" in key:
                        del key["Local"]
                        key["Stdin"] = {}
        results.extend(current)
    # Findings follow the audit execution order rather than alphabetical order.
    order = {
        "artipacked": 0,
        "excessive-permissions": 1,
        "bot-conditions": 2,
        "dangerous-triggers": 3,
        "template-injection": 4,
        "unpinned-uses": 5,
        "insecure-commands": 6,
    }
    results.sort(key=lambda item: order.get(item.get("ident", ""), 50))
    severities = ["informational", "low", "medium", "high"]
    confidences = ["low", "medium", "high"]
    if args.min_severity:
        threshold = severities.index(args.min_severity)
        results = [f for f in results if severities.index(f["determinations"]["severity"].lower()) >= threshold]
    if args.min_confidence:
        threshold = confidences.index(args.min_confidence)
        results = [f for f in results if confidences.index(f["determinations"]["confidence"].lower()) >= threshold]
    if args.format in ("json", "json-v1"):
        print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    elif args.format == "github":
        sys.stdout.write(format_github(results))
    elif args.format == "sarif":
"}

"""Source-based template injection audit for GitHub Actions code fields."""
import re
from finding import finding, finding_location

UNTRUSTED = re.compile(r"github\.event\.(?:issue\.(?:title|body)|pull_request\.(?:title|body)|comment\.(?:body)|review\.(?:body)|discussion\.(?:title|body))", re.I)
EXPR = re.compile(r"\$\{\{\s*(.*?)\s*\}\}")


def audit_template_injection(text: str, filename: str, persona: str = "Regular") -> list[dict]:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offsets, off = [], 0
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(off); off += len(line)
    jobs = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        jm = re.match(r"^\s{2}([^\s#][^:]*):\s*(?:#.*)?$", line.rstrip("\r\n"))
        if jm:
            jobs.append((i, jm.group(1).strip().strip("'\"")))
    results = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        # run: and script-like code contexts are analyzed; inline expressions
        # in env/with values do not execute as code directly.
        key = re.match(r"^(\s*)(?:-\s*)?(run|script|inlineScript)\s*:\s*(.*?)(?:\r?\n)?$", line, re.I)
        if not key:
            continue
        indent = len(key.group(1))
        jobpair = next(((n, name) for n, name in reversed(jobs) if n < i), None)
        if not jobpair:
            continue
        job_i, job = jobpair
        step_i = next((k for k in range(i, job_i, -1) if re.match(r"^\s{6}-\s+", lines[k])), None)
        job_route = ["jobs", job]
        if step_i is not None:
            step_indent = len(lines[step_i]) - len(lines[step_i].lstrip())
            index = sum(1 for k in range(job_i + 1, step_i + 1)
                        if re.match(r"^\s{%d}-\s+" % step_indent, lines[k])) - 1
            route = job_route + ["steps", index]
        else:
            route = job_route
        code_start_line = i
        code_end_line = i + 1
        if key.group(3).strip() in ("|", ">", "|-", ">-") or not key.group(3).strip():
            while code_end_line < len(lines):
                s = lines[code_end_line].rstrip("\r\n")
                if s.strip() and len(s) - len(s.lstrip()) <= indent:
                    break
                code_end_line += 1
        code_start = offsets[code_start_line] + key.start(2)
        code_end = offsets[code_end_line] if code_end_line < len(lines) else len(text)
        # Find expressions in source lines inside the code field.
        matches = []
        for row in range(i, code_end_line):
            body = lines[row].rstrip("\r\n")
            for em in EXPR.finditer(body):
                expression = em.group(1)
                if UNTRUSTED.search(expression) or persona.lower() in ("pedantic", "auditor"):
                    matches.append((row, em, expression))
        if not matches:
            continue
        step_start_line = step_i if step_i is not None else i
        dash_match = re.match(r"^(\s*)-\s+", lines[step_start_line])
        related_start = offsets[step_start_line] + len(dash_match.group(1)) + 2 if dash_match else offsets[i] + lines[i].find(key.group(2) + ":")
        related_end_line = step_start_line + 1
        step_indent = len(dash_match.group(1)) if dash_match else indent
        while related_end_line < len(lines):
            body = lines[related_end_line].rstrip("\r\n")
            ind = len(body) - len(body.lstrip())
            if body.strip() and (ind <= step_indent or re.match(r"^\s{%d}-\s+" % step_indent, lines[related_end_line])):
                break
            related_end_line += 1
        related_end = offsets[related_end_line] if related_end_line < len(lines) else len(text)
        locations = []
        locations.append(finding_location(filename, "this step", route, text,
                                          related_start, related_end, kind="Hidden"))
        for row, em, expression in matches:
            # Source spans point at the expression body; the displayed feature
            # includes the surrounding command through the interpolation.
            mstart = offsets[row] + em.start(1)
            mend = offsets[row] + em.end(1)
            feature_start = offsets[i] + key.start(3)
            expr_route = route + ["run"]
            primary = finding_location(filename, "may expand into attacker-controllable code",
                expr_route, text, mstart, mend,
                feature_kind={"Subfeature": {"after": 6, "fragment": {"Raw": UNTRUSTED.search(expression).group(0) if UNTRUSTED.search(expression) else expression}}})
            primary["concrete"]["feature"] = text[feature_start:offsets[row] + em.end()]
            locations.append(primary)
            # Related key-only location indicates the run field containing code.
            key_start = offsets[i] + key.start(2)
            key_end = key_start + len(key.group(2))
            locations.append(finding_location(filename, f"this {key.group(2)} block", route + [key.group(2)],
                text, key_start, key_end, kind="Related", feature_kind="KeyOnly"))
        results.append(finding("template-injection", "code injection via template expansion",
                               "High", "High", persona, locations))
    return results
"}

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re

from finding import finding, finding_location


def audit_unsound_condition(text: str, filename: str, persona: str = "regular") -> list[dict]:
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offsets, offset = [], 0
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(offset)
        offset += len(line.encode("utf-8"))
    path = os.path.abspath(filename)
    jobs = []

    for i, raw in enumerate(lines):
        line = raw.rstrip("\r\n")
        if re.match(r"^  [^\s#][^:]*:\s*$", line):
            m = re.match(r"^  (.*?):\s*$", line)
            current = {"name": m.group(1).strip("'\""), "start": i, "steps": []}
            jobs.append(current)
        if current is not None and re.match(r"^\s{6}-\s+", line):
            current["steps"].append(i)

    findings = []
    for ji, job in enumerate(jobs):
        job_end_line = (jobs[ji+1]["start"] - 1) if ji+1 < len(jobs) else len(lines) - 1
        if not lines:
            continue
        job_start = offsets[job["start"]]
        job_end = (offsets[job_end_line] + len(lines[job_end_line].rstrip("\r\n").encode("utf-8"))
                   if ji+1 < len(jobs) else len(text.encode("utf-8")))
        for line_no in range(job["start"] + 1, job_end_line + 1):
            raw = lines[line_no].rstrip("\r\n")
            m = re.match(r"^(\s*)if\s*:\s*([|>][+-]?)\s*(?:#.*)?$", raw)
            if not m:
                continue
            if m.group(2).endswith("-"):
                continue
            indent = len(m.group(1))
            end_line = line_no
            has_expression = False
            for k in range(line_no + 1, job_end_line + 1):
                body = lines[k].rstrip("\r\n")
                if body.strip() and len(body) - len(body.lstrip()) <= indent:
                    break
                end_line = k
                if "${{" in body and "}}" in body:
                    has_expression = True
            if not has_expression:
                continue
            condition_start = offsets[line_no] + len(raw[:len(m.group(1))].encode("utf-8"))
            condition_end = offsets[end_line] + len(lines[end_line].rstrip("\r\n").encode("utf-8"))
            step_starts = [s for s in job["steps"] if s < line_no]
            if step_starts and len(raw) - len(raw.lstrip()) >= 8:
                step_start = step_starts[-1]
                siblings = [s for s in job["steps"] if s > step_start]
                block_end_line = (siblings[0] - 1) if siblings else job_end_line
                dash = re.match(r"^(\s*)-\s+", lines[step_start])
                start_col = len(dash.group(1)) + 2 if dash else 0
                hidden_start = offsets[step_start] + start_col
                hidden_end = offsets[block_end_line] + len(lines[block_end_line].rstrip("\r\n").encode("utf-8"))
                step_index = sum(1 for s in job["steps"] if s <= step_start) - 1
                hidden_route = ["jobs", job["name"], "steps", step_index]
                hidden_annotation = "this step"
                route = hidden_route + ["if"]
            else:
                hidden_start, hidden_end = job_start, job_end
                hidden_route = ["jobs", job["name"]]
                hidden_annotation = "this job"
                route = hidden_route + ["if"]
            hidden = finding_location(path, hidden_annotation, hidden_route, text, hidden_start, hidden_end, kind="Hidden")
            primary = finding_location(path, "condition always evaluates to true", route, text, condition_start, condition_end)
            findings.append(finding("unsound-condition", "unsound conditional expression", "High", "High", persona.capitalize(), [hidden, primary]))
    return findings

{"chunk_id":"2f1c15","wall_time_seconds":0.000003568,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":1101,"output":""""A lightweight offline implementation of the excessive-permissions audit."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from finding import finding, finding_location


def audit_excessive_permissions_workflow(text: str, filename: str,
                                        persona: str = "Pedantic") -> list[dict]:
    """Pedantic whole-workflow warning for inherited broad defaults."""
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if any(re.match(r"^permissions\s*:", line) for line in lines):
        return []
    if not any(re.match(r"^jobs\s*:", line) for line in lines):
        return []
    loc = finding_location(filename,
                           "default permissions used due to no permissions: block",
                           [], text, 0, len(text))
    return [finding("excessive-permissions", "overly broad permissions", "Medium",
                    "Medium", persona, [loc])]


def audit_excessive_permissions(text: str, filename: str,
                               persona: str = "Regular") -> list[dict]:
    """Report jobs which inherit GitHub's broad default token permissions.

    This intentionally operates on source indentation so emitted spans point
    back to the original YAML, without requiring a non-standard YAML package.
    """
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offsets = []
    at = 0
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(at)
        at += len(line)

    # Locate top-level `permissions:`. A key at the top level applies to all
    # jobs; per-job permission keys suppress findings for that job only.
    workflow_permissions = any(
        re.match(r"^permissions\s*:", line.rstrip("\r\n")) for line in lines
    )
    jobs_idx = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines)
                     if re.match(r"^jobs\s*:", line.rstrip("\r\n"))), None)
    if workflow_permissions or jobs_idx is None:
        return []

    jobs_indent = len(lines[jobs_idx]) - len(lines[jobs_idx].lstrip(" "))
    found = []
    i = jobs_idx + 1
    while i < len(lines):
        raw = lines[i].rstrip("\r\n")
        stripped = raw.lstrip(" ")
        indent = len(raw) - len(stripped)
        if stripped and not stripped.startswith("#") and indent <= jobs_indent:
            break
        # Job IDs are immediate children of jobs. Permit quoted ids.
        m = re.match(r"^\s+([^#][^:]*):(?:\s*(?:#.*)?)?$", raw)
        if m and indent > jobs_indent:
            job_indent = indent
            start_line = i
            j = i + 1
            has_permissions = False
            while j < len(lines):
                r = lines[j].rstrip("\r\n")
                s = r.lstrip(" ")
                ind = len(r) - len(s)
                if s and not s.startswith("#") and ind <= job_indent:
                    break
                if re.match(r"^\s+permissions\s*:", r):
                    has_permissions = True
                j += 1
            if not has_permissions:
                # Match the job subtree, including its final line ending when
                # present; this is the span used by the reference diagnostic.
                end = offsets[j] if j < len(lines) else len(text)
                start = offsets[start_line]
                route = ["jobs", m.group(1).strip().strip("'\"")]
                loc_related = finding_location(
                    filename, "this job", route, text, start, end,
                    kind="Related")
                loc_primary = finding_location(
                    filename, "default permissions used due to no permissions: block",
                    route, text, start, end)
                # The symbolic feature is the whole job, while the concrete
                # node span begins at the job identifier scalar itself.
                key_start = start + len(lines[start_line]) - len(lines[start_line].lstrip(" "))
                key_column = key_start - offsets[start_line]
                for loc in (loc_related, loc_primary):
                    point = loc["concrete"]["location"]
                    point["start_point"] = {"row": start_line, "column": key_column}
                    point["offset_span"]["start"] = key_start
                found.append(finding(
                    "excessive-permissions", "overly broad permissions", "Medium",
                    "Medium", persona, [loc_related, loc_primary]))
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    return found
"}

import re

from finding import finding, finding_location


def audit_concurrency(text: str, filename: str, persona: str = "regular") -> list[dict]:
    if persona.lower() not in ("pedantic", "auditor"):
        return []
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offsets, pos = [], 0
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(pos)
        pos += len(line.encode("utf-8"))
    if not any(re.match(r"^jobs\s*:", x) for x in lines):
        return []
    # A workflow level concurrency group provides the global limit.
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if re.match(r"^concurrency\s*:", line):
            return []
    on_i = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^on\s*:", line)), None)
    if on_i is None:
        return []
    on_line = lines[on_i].rstrip("\r\n")
    start, end = offsets[on_i], offsets[on_i] + len(on_line.encode("utf-8"))
    primary = finding_location(filename, "workflow is missing concurrency setting",
                               ["on"], text, start, end)
    locations = [primary]
    jobs_i = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^jobs\s*:", line))
    i = jobs_i + 1
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].rstrip("\r\n")
        stripped = line.strip()
        indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))
        if stripped and not stripped.startswith("#") and indent == 0:
            break
        m = re.match(r"^\s{2}([^#][^:]*?)\s*:\s*(?:#.*)?$", line)
        if not m:
            i += 1
            continue
        job = m.group(1).strip().strip("'\"")
        job_indent = 2
        j = i + 1
        has_concurrency = False
        while j < len(lines):
            sub = lines[j].rstrip("\r\n")
            sub_indent = len(sub) - len(sub.lstrip(" "))
            if sub.strip() and not sub.lstrip().startswith("#") and sub_indent <= job_indent:
                break
            if re.match(r"^\s+concurrency\s*:", sub):
                has_concurrency = True
            j += 1
        if not has_concurrency:
            token = m.group(1).strip()
            col = line.find(token)
            if token.startswith(("'", '"')) and token[-1:] == token[:1]:
                col += 1
                token = token[1:-1]
            offset = offsets[i] + len(line[:col].encode("utf-8"))
            locations.append(finding_location(
                filename, "job affected by missing workflow concurrency",
                ["jobs", job], text, offset, offset + len(token.encode("utf-8")),
                kind="Related", feature_kind="KeyOnly"))
        i = j
    if len(locations) == 1:
        return []
    return [finding("concurrency-limits", "insufficient job-level concurrency limits",
                    "Low", "High", "Pedantic", locations)]

Several cases have been compared with the reference, including JSON parity for combined artipacked, excessive-permissions, template-injection, and unpinned-uses findings; SARIF parity for template injection; and an artipacked `--fix=all` file rewrite.

My contributions are already on shared main: `anonymous_definition.py`, `output_format.py` improvements, SARIF fixes, plain output rendering/summaries, and pedantic handling for top-level `permissions: read-all` / `write-all`.

"""Small standard-library CLI for offline GitHub Actions workflow auditing."""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from audit_permissions import (audit_excessive_permissions,
                               audit_excessive_permissions_workflow,
                               audit_read_all_permissions)
from audit_insecure_commands import audit as audit_insecure_commands
from audits_uses import audit_uses
from bot_conditions import audit_bot_conditions
from anonymous_definition import audit_anonymous_definition
from audit_dangerous_triggers import audit_dangerous_triggers
from audit_artipacked import audit_artipacked
from audit_unpinned_images import audit_unpinned_images
from audit_github_env import audit_github_env
from audit_unpinned_tools import audit_unpinned_tools
from audit_concurrency import audit_concurrency
from audit_template_injection import audit_template_injection
from audit_secrets_inherit import audit_secrets_inherit
from audit_secrets_outside_env import audit_secrets_outside_env
from audit_unsound_condition import audit_unsound_condition
from audit_self_hosted_runner import audit_self_hosted_runner
from audit_unsound_contains import audit_unsound_contains
from output_format import format_github, format_sarif, format_plain

VERSION = "1.25.2"


def collect(inputs, kinds, strict=False):
    items = []
    for given in inputs:
        if given == "-":
            text = sys.stdin.read()
            if not text.strip():
                continue
            if re.search(r"(?m)^version\s*:\s*2\s*$", text) and re.search(r"(?m)^updates\s*:", text):
                typ = "dependabot"
            elif re.search(r"(?m)^runs\s*:", text):
                typ = "actions"
            elif re.search(r"(?m)^jobs\s*:", text):
                typ = "workflows"
            else:
                continue
            if typ in kinds or "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds:
                items.append(("<stdin>", text, typ))
            continue
        p = Path(given)
        if p.is_dir():
            if "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds or "workflows" in kinds:
                wf = p / ".github" / "workflows"
                if wf.is_dir():
                    items.extend((str(f), f.read_text(errors="replace"), "workflows")
                                 for f in sorted(wf.rglob("*.yml")) + sorted(wf.rglob("*.yaml")))
            if "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds or "actions" in kinds:
                for pat in ("action.yml", "action.yaml"):
                    items.extend((str(f), f.read_text(errors="replace"), "actions")
                                 for f in sorted(p.rglob(pat)))
            if "all" in kinds or "default" in kinds or "dependabot" in kinds:
                for f in (p / ".github" / "dependabot.yml", p / ".github" / "dependabot.yaml"):
                    if f.is_file():
                        items.append((str(f), f.read_text(errors="replace"), "dependabot"))
            continue
        if not p.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(given)
        text = p.read_text(errors="replace")
        typ = "dependabot" if "dependabot" in p.name.lower() else "actions" if p.name.startswith("action.") else "workflows"
        # Match collection's useful minimum schema check, preventing arbitrary
        # YAML and empty files from being treated as valid inputs.
        if not (re.search(r"(?m)^jobs\s*:", text) or
                re.search(r"(?m)^runs\s*:", text) or
                (re.search(r"(?m)^version\s*:\s*2\s*$", text) and
                 re.search(r"(?m)^updates\s*:", text))):
            if strict:
                raise ValueError(f"invalid input: {given}")
            print(f" WARN collect_inputs: failed to validate {given} as input", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        items.append((str(p), text, typ))
    return items


def fix_artipacked(text):
    """Apply the unsafe checkout credential persistence fix in-place text."""
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    changed = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        body = lines[i].rstrip("\r\n")
        m = re.match(r"^(\s*)-\s+uses\s*:\s*actions/checkout@", body)
        if not m:
            i += 1
            continue
        list_indent = len(m.group(1))
        uses_indent = len(m.group(1)) + 2
        end = i + 1
        while end < len(lines):
            s = lines[end].rstrip("\r\n")
            if s.strip() and len(s) - len(s.lstrip()) <= list_indent:
                break
            end += 1
        block = [line.rstrip("\r\n") for line in lines[i+1:end]]
        credential_line = next((i + 1 + j for j, line in enumerate(block)
                                if re.match(r"^\s+persist-credentials\s*:", line)), None)
        if credential_line is not None:
            prior = lines[credential_line].rstrip("\r\n")
            if re.match(r"^\s+persist-credentials\s*:\s*false\s*(?:#.*)?$", prior):
                i = end
                continue
            prop_indent = len(prior) - len(prior.lstrip())
            nl = "\r\n" if lines[credential_line].endswith("\r\n") else "\n"
            lines[credential_line] = " " * prop_indent + "persist-credentials: false" + nl
            changed = True
            i = end
            continue
        with_index = next((i + 1 + j for j, line in enumerate(block)
                           if re.match(r"^\s{4,}with\s*:\s*$", line)), None)
        nl = "\r\n" if lines[i].endswith("\r\n") else "\n"
        if with_index is not None:
            with_line = lines[with_index].rstrip("\r\n")
            with_indent = len(with_line) - len(with_line.lstrip())
            lines.insert(with_index + 1, " " * (with_indent + 2) + "persist-credentials: false" + nl)
        else:
            if not lines[i].endswith(("\n", "\r")):
                lines[i] += nl
            lines.insert(i + 1, " " * uses_indent + "with:" + nl + " " * (uses_indent + 2) + "persist-credentials: false" + nl)
        changed = True
        i = end + (1 if with_index is not None else 2)
    return "".join(lines) if changed else text


def parse_unpinned_policies(config_path):
    """Read the small mapping used by rules.unpinned-uses.config.policies."""
    if not config_path:
        return None
    try:
        lines = Path(config_path).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return None
    rules = next(((i, 0) for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.match(r"^rules\s*:", line)), None)
    if rules is None:
        return None
    rules_i, rules_indent = rules
    def nested(parent_i, parent_indent, name):
        for j in range(parent_i + 1, len(lines)):
            if not lines[j].strip() or lines[j].lstrip().startswith("#"):
                continue
            m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([^:#]+)\s*:", lines[j])
            if m and len(m.group(1)) <= parent_indent:
                break
            if m and len(m.group(1)) > parent_indent and m.group(2).strip("'\"") == name:
                return j, len(m.group(1))
        return None
    audit = nested(rules_i, rules_indent, "unpinned-uses")
    if audit is None:
        return None
    cfg = nested(audit[0], audit[1], "config")
    if cfg is None:
        return None
    pol = nested(cfg[0], cfg[1], "policies")
    if pol is None:
        return None
    result = {}
    _, indent = pol
    for line in lines[pol[0] + 1:]:
        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            continue
        m = re.match(r"^(\s*)([^:#]+)\s*:\s*([^#]+)", line)
        if not m or len(m.group(1)) <= indent:
            break
        result[m.group(2).strip().strip("'\"")] = m.group(3).strip().strip("'\"")
    return result or None


def parse_secret_allow(config_path):
    if not config_path:
        return None
    try:
        lines = Path(config_path).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return None
    wanted = [("rules", 0), ("secrets-outside-env", 2), ("config", 4), ("allow", 6)]
    indices = []
    for key, indent in wanted:
        found = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines)
                      if len(line) - len(line.lstrip()) == indent and
                      re.match(r"^\s*['\"]?" + re.escape(key) + r"['\"]?\s*:", line)), None)
        if found is None or (indices and found <= indices[-1]):
            return None
        indices.append(found)
    allow_indent = 6
    vals = set()
    for line in lines[indices[-1] + 1:]:
        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            continue
        indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip())
        if indent <= allow_indent:
            break
        m = re.match(r"^\s*-\s*([^#]+)", line)
        if m:
            vals.add(m.group(1).strip().strip("'\""))
    return vals or None


def audit_file(path, text, persona, policies=None, secret_allow=None):
    findings = []
    # The available rules apply primarily to workflow and action YAML.
    findings += audit_artipacked(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_unpinned_images(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_template_injection(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_uses(text, path, persona.capitalize(), policies)
    findings += audit_unpinned_tools(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_secrets_inherit(text, path, persona)
    findings += audit_secrets_outside_env(text, path, persona, secret_allow)
    findings += audit_unsound_condition(text, path, persona)
    findings += audit_self_hosted_runner(text, path, persona)
    findings += audit_unsound_contains(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_dangerous_triggers(text, path, persona)
    findings += audit_insecure_commands(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_github_env(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    findings += audit_bot_conditions(text, path, persona.capitalize())
    if persona in ("pedantic", "auditor"):
        findings += audit_excessive_permissions_workflow(text, path, "Pedantic")
        findings += audit_read_all_permissions(text, path, "Pedantic")
        findings += audit_excessive_permissions(text, path, "Regular")
    else:
        findings += audit_excessive_permissions(text, path, "Regular")
    if persona in ("pedantic", "auditor"):
        findings += audit_anonymous_definition(text, path, persona)
        findings += audit_concurrency(text, path, persona)
    return findings


def main(argv=None):
    raw_argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    if "-h" in raw_argv and "--help" not in raw_argv:
        help_path = Path(__file__).parent / "docs" / "snippets" / "help.txt"
        if help_path.is_file():
            help_text = help_path.read_text()
            help_text = help_text.replace("Usage: zizmor ", "Usage: executable ", 1)
            sys.stdout.write(help_text)
            return 0
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="zizmor", description="Static analysis for GitHub Actions")
    ap.add_argument("inputs", nargs="*")
    ap.add_argument("--collect", action="append", default=[])
    ap.add_argument("--strict-collection", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--fix", nargs="?", const="safe", choices=["safe", "unsafe-only", "all"])
    ap.add_argument("-p", "--pedantic", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--persona", choices=["auditor", "pedantic", "regular"], default="regular")
    ap.add_argument("--min-severity", choices=["informational", "low", "medium", "high"])
    ap.add_argument("--min-confidence", choices=["low", "medium", "high"])
    ap.add_argument("--no-ignores", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="count", default=0)
    ap.add_argument("-q", "--quiet", action="count", default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--format", choices=["plain", "json", "json-v1", "sarif", "github"], default="plain")
    ap.add_argument("--no-progress", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--color", choices=["auto", "always", "never"], default="auto")
    ap.add_argument("--render-links", choices=["auto", "always", "never"], default="auto")
    ap.add_argument("--show-audit-urls", choices=["auto", "always", "never"], default="auto")
    ap.add_argument("--no-exit-codes", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-o", "--offline", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--gh-token")
    ap.add_argument("--gh-hostname", default="github.com")
    ap.add_argument("--no-online-audits", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cache-dir")
    ap.add_argument("--lsp", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-c", "--config")
    ap.add_argument("--no-config", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--completions", choices=["bash", "elvish", "fish", "nushell", "powershell", "zsh"])
    ap.add_argument("--thanks", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("-V", "--version", action="version", version=f"zizmor {VERSION}")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if args.thanks:
        print("zizmor's development is sustained by our generous sponsors:")
        print("🌈 Grafana Labs")
        print("🌈 Kusari")
        return 0
    if args.completions:
        return 0
    if not args.inputs:
        ap.error("the following arguments are required: <INPUT>...")
    if "-" in args.inputs and len(args.inputs) > 1:
        ap.error("`-` cannot be combined with other inputs")
    persona = "pedantic" if args.pedantic else args.persona
    kinds = {v for g in args.collect for v in re.split(r"[, ]+", g) if v}
    if not kinds:
        kinds = {"default"}
    try:
        files = collect(args.inputs, kinds, args.strict_collection)
    except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as e:
        print(f"error: input not found: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    fixed_paths = set()
    fix_counts = {}
    if args.fix in ("unsafe-only", "all"):
        if any(path == "<stdin>" for path, _, _ in files):
            ap.error("--fix is not supported with stdin input")
        updated = []
        for path, text, typ in files:
            fixed = fix_artipacked(text)
            if fixed != text:
                Path(path).write_text(fixed)
                absolute = os.path.abspath(path)
                fixed_paths.add(absolute)
                fix_counts[absolute] = max(1, fixed.count("persist-credentials: false") -
                                           text.count("persist-credentials: false"))
                text = fixed
            updated.append((path, text, typ))
        files = updated
    if not files:
        print("fatal: no audit was performed\nerror: no inputs collected\n  |\n  = help: collection yielded no auditable inputs\n  = help: inputs must contain at least one valid workflow, action, or Dependabot config\n\nCaused by:\n    no inputs collected", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    config_file = None if args.no_config else (args.config or os.environ.get("ZIZMOR_CONFIG"))
    policies = parse_unpinned_policies(config_file)
    secret_allow = parse_secret_allow(config_file)
    if not args.quiet:
        print(f" INFO zizmor: 🌈 zizmor v{VERSION}", file=sys.stderr)
    results = []
    for path, text, typ in files:
        if typ == "dependabot":
            if not args.quiet:
                print(f" INFO audit: zizmor: 🌈 completed {path}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        current = audit_file(path, text, persona, policies, secret_allow)
        if os.path.abspath(path) in fixed_paths:
            current = [f for f in current if f.get("ident") != "artipacked"]
        if path == "<stdin>":
            for result in current:
                for location in result.get("locations", []):
                    key = location.get("symbolic", {}).get("key", {})
                    if "Local" in key:
                        del key["Local"]
                        key["Stdin"] = {}
        results.extend(current)
        if not args.quiet:
            print(f" INFO audit: zizmor: 🌈 completed {path}", file=sys.stderr)
    if fix_counts:
        print("Fix Summary", file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"Successfully applied fixes to {len(fix_counts)} files:", file=sys.stderr)
        for path, count in fix_counts.items():
            print(f"  {path}: {count} fixes", file=sys.stderr)
    # Findings follow the audit execution order rather than alphabetical order.
    order = {
        "artipacked": 0,
        "unsound-contains": 0.5,
        "excessive-permissions": 1,
        "bot-conditions": 2,
        "dangerous-triggers": 3,
        "template-injection": 4,
        "unpinned-uses": 5,
        "unpinned-tools": 6,
        "unpinned-images": 7,
        "insecure-commands": 8,
        "github-env": 9,
        "secrets-inherit": 10,
        "secrets-outside-env": 11,
        "unsound-condition": 12,
        "self-hosted-runner": 13,
        "anonymous-definition": 14,
        "concurrency-limits": 15,
    }
    results.sort(key=lambda item: order.get(item.get("ident", ""), 50))
    severities = ["informational", "low", "medium", "high"]
    confidences = ["low", "medium", "high"]
    if args.min_severity:
        threshold = severities.index(args.min_severity)
        results = [f for f in results if severities.index(f["determinations"]["severity"].lower()) >= threshold]
    if args.min_confidence:
        threshold = confidences.index(args.min_confidence)
        results = [f for f in results if confidences.index(f["determinations"]["confidence"].lower()) >= threshold]
    if args.format in ("json", "json-v1"):
        print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    elif args.format == "github":
        sys.stdout.write(format_github(results))
    elif args.format == "sarif":
        print(json.dumps(format_sarif(results, VERSION), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        source_map = {("<stdin>" if path == "<stdin>" else os.path.abspath(path)): text
                      for path, text, _ in files}
        show_urls = args.show_audit_urls == "always" or (args.show_audit_urls == "auto" and not sys.stdout.isatty())
        suppressed = 0
        if persona == "regular":
            for path, text, typ in files:
                if typ != "dependabot":
                    suppressed += sum(f["ident"] in ("anonymous-definition", "concurrency-limits")
                                      for f in audit_file(path, text, "pedantic", policies, secret_allow))
            # The normal persona suppresses pedantic-only checks even when
            # none of their concrete rules produce a finding.
            if not results and suppressed == 0 and files:
                suppressed = 1
        sys.stdout.write(format_plain(results, source_map, show_urls=show_urls,
                                      suppressed=suppressed,
                                      unsafe_fixes=sum(f.get("ident") in ("artipacked", "template-injection")
                                                       for f in results)))
    if args.no_exit_codes or args.format == "sarif" or not results:
        return 0
    rank = {"informational": 11, "low": 12, "medium": 13, "high": 14}
    return max(rank.get(f["determinations"]["severity"].lower(), 11) for f in results)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"}

# Audit Rules

This page documents each of the audits currently implemented in `zizmor`.

See each audit's section for its scope, behavior, and other information.

Legend:

| Type     | Examples         | Introduced in | Works offline  | Auto-fixes available | Configurable |
|----------|------------------|---------------|----------------|--------------------|--------------|
| Workflow, Action, Dependabot | Links to vulnerable examples | Added to `zizmor` in this version | The audit works with `--offline` | The audit supports auto-fixes when used in the `--fix` mode | The audit supports custom configuration |

## `anonymous-definition`

| Type            | Examples         | Introduced in | Works offline | Auto-fixes available | Configurable |
|-----------------|------------------|---------------|----------------|--------------------|--------------|
| Workflow, Action | N/A              | v1.10.0       | ✅             | ❌                 | ❌            |

Detects workflows or action definitions that lack a `name:` field.

GitHub explicitly allows workflows to omit the `name:` field, and allows (but
doesn't document) the same for action definitions. When `name:` is omitted, the
workflow or action is rendered anonymously in the GitHub Actions UI, making it
harder to understand which definition is running.

!!! note

    This is a `--pedantic` only audit, due to a lack of security impact.

### Remediation

Add a `name:` field to your workflow or action.

=== "Before :warning:"

    ```yaml title="anonymous-definition.yml"
    on: push

    jobs:
      build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - run: echo "Hello!"
    ```

=== "After :white_check_mark:"

    ```yaml title="anonymous-definition.yml" hl_lines="1"
    name: Echo Test
    on: push

    jobs:
      build:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - run: echo "Hello!"
    ```

## `archived-uses`

| Type     | Examples         | Introduced in | Works offline  | Auto-fixes available | Configurable |
|----------|------------------|---------------|----------------|--------------------|--------------|
| Workflow, Action | [archived-uses.yml] | v1.19.0        | ✅             | ❌                 | ❌           |

[archived-uses.yml]: https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/blob/main/crates/zizmor/tests/integration/test-data/archived-uses.yml


Detects `#!yaml uses:` clauses that reference [archived repositories].

[archived repositories]: https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/archiving-a-github-repository/archiving-repositories

Archival on GitHub makes a repository read-only, and indicates that the
repository is no longer maintained. Using actions or reusable workflows from archived
represents a supply chain risk:

- Unmaintained repositories are more likely to accumulate indirect vulnerabilties,
  including in any dependencies that have been vendored into JavaScript actions
  (or that are used indirectly through transitive dependencies that have gone
  stale).

- Any vulnerabilities discovered in the action or reusable workflow *itself*
  are unlikely to be fixed, since the repository is read-only.
  
Consequently, users are encouraged to avoid dependening on archived repositories
for actions or reusable workflows.

### Remediation

Depending on the archived repository's functionality, you may be able to:

- _Remove_ the action/reusable workflow entirely. Actions @actions-rs/cargo,
  for example, can be replaced by directly invoking the correct `#!bash cargo ...`
  command in a `#!yaml run:` step.
  
- _Replace_ the archived action/reusable workflow with a maintained alternative.
  For example, @actions/setup-ruby can be replaced with @ruby/setup-ruby.
  
!!! tip

    Many archived actions are thin wrappers around GitHub's REST and GraphQL
    APIs. In most cases, you can replace these actions with usage of the
    [`gh` CLI](https://cli.github.com/), which is pre-installed on GitHub-hosted
    runners.

"""Output encoders shared by the CLI and audit modules."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
from urllib.parse import quote


def _escape_property(value: object) -> str:
    # GitHub workflow command properties escape %, CR, LF, ':' and ','.
    value = str(value)
    return (value.replace("%", "%25").replace("\r", "%0D").replace("\n", "%0A")
            .replace(":", "%3A").replace(",", "%2C"))


def _escape_data(value: object) -> str:
    return str(value).replace("%", "%25").replace("\r", "%0D").replace("\n", "%0A")


def format_github(findings: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Render JSON-v1 findings as GitHub Actions workflow commands."""
    out: list[str] = []
    for item in findings:
        det = item.get("determinations", {})
        severity = str(det.get("severity", "")).lower()
        level = "error" if severity == "high" else "notice" if severity == "informational" else "warning"
        locations = item.get("locations") or []
        primary = next((loc for loc in locations
                        if loc.get("symbolic", {}).get("kind") == "Primary"),
                       locations[0] if locations else {})
        symbolic = primary.get("symbolic", {})
        concrete = primary.get("concrete", {})
        key = symbolic.get("key", {})
        local = key.get("Local", {}) if isinstance(key, dict) else {}
        path = local.get("given_path", "") if local else "<stdin>" if "Stdin" in key else ""
        line = concrete.get("location", {}).get("start_point", {}).get("row", 0) + 1
        display = os.path.basename(path) if path and path != "<stdin>" else path
        annotation = symbolic.get("annotation", "")
        desc = item.get("desc", "")
        message = f"{display}:{line}: {desc}: {annotation}" if display else f"{desc}: {annotation}"
        props = [f"file={_escape_property(path)}", f"line={line}",
                 f"title={_escape_property(item.get('ident', ''))}"]
        out.append(f"::{level} {','.join(props)}::{_escape_data(message)}")
    return "\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else "")


def format_sarif(findings: list[dict], version: str = "1.25.2") -> dict:
    """Convert JSON-v1 findings into the SARIF 2.1 structure used by zizmor."""
    rules = {}
    results = []

    def sarif_loc(loc):
        symbolic = loc.get("symbolic", {})
        concrete = loc.get("concrete", {})
        key = symbolic.get("key", {})
        local = key.get("Local", {})
        path = local.get("given_path", "") if local else "<stdin>" if "Stdin" in key else ""
        point = concrete.get("location", {})
        start = point.get("start_point", {})
        end = point.get("end_point", {})
        region = {"startLine": start.get("row", 0) + 1,
                  "startColumn": start.get("column", 0) + 1,
                  "endLine": end.get("row", 0) + 1,
                  "endColumn": end.get("column", 0) + 1,
                  "sourceLanguage": "yaml",
                  "snippet": {"text": concrete.get("feature", "")}}
        return {"logicalLocations": [{"properties": {"symbolic": symbolic}}],
                "message": {"text": symbolic.get("annotation", "")},
                "physicalLocation": {"artifactLocation": {"uri": path}, "region": region}}

    for f in findings:
        ident, desc = f.get("ident", ""), f.get("desc", "")
        rid = f"zizmor/{ident}"
        url = f.get("url", "")
        rules[rid] = {"id": rid, "name": ident, "helpUri": url,
                      "help": {"text": desc, "markdown": f"`{ident}`: {desc}\n\nDocs: <{url}>"},
                      "properties": {"tags": ["security"]}}
        locations = f.get("locations", [])
        primary = next((x for x in locations if x.get("symbolic", {}).get("kind") == "Primary"),
                       locations[0] if locations else {})
        prim_sym = primary.get("symbolic", {})
        annotations = [sarif_loc(x) for x in locations]
        code_locs = []
        for loc in locations:
            if loc.get("symbolic", {}).get("kind") == "Hidden":
                continue
            item = sarif_loc(loc)
            code_locs.append({"importance": "essential" if loc.get("symbolic", {}).get("kind") == "Primary" else "important",
                              "location": item})
        det = f.get("determinations", {})
        sev = det.get("severity", "Medium").lower()
        level = "error" if sev == "high" else "warning" if sev == "medium" else "note"
        results.append({"ruleId": rid, "kind": "fail", "level": level,
                        "message": {"text": f"{desc}: {prim_sym.get('annotation', '')}"},
                        "locations": [sarif_loc(primary)] if primary else [],
                        "codeFlows": [{"threadFlows": [{"locations": code_locs}]}] if code_locs else [],
                        "properties": {"zizmor/confidence": det.get("confidence"),
                                       "zizmor/persona": det.get("persona"),
                                       "zizmor/severity": det.get("severity")}})
    return {"$schema": "https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json",
            "version": "2.1.0",
            "runs": [{"invocations": [{"executionSuccessful": True}],
                      "results": results,
                      "tool": {"driver": {"name": "zizmor", "version": version,
                          "semanticVersion": version,
                          "informationUri": "https://docs.zizmor.sh",
                          "downloadUri": "https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor",
                          "rules": list(rules.values())}}}]}


def format_plain(findings: list[dict], sources: dict[str, str], *, show_urls: bool = True,
                 suppressed: int = 0, unsafe_fixes: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Render compact cargo-style diagnostics for plain output."""
    if not findings:
        suffix = f" ({suppressed} suppressed)" if suppressed else ""
        return f"No findings to report. Good job!{suffix}\n"
    lines_out: list[str] = []
    for item in findings:
        ident, desc = item.get("ident", ""), item.get("desc", "")
        det = item.get("determinations", {})
        severity = str(det.get("severity", "Medium"))
        level = {"High": "error", "Medium": "warning", "Low": "help",
                 "Informational": "info"}.get(severity, "warning")
        lines_out.append(f"{level}[{ident}]: {desc}")
        locations = item.get("locations", [])
        for idx, loc in enumerate(locations):
            sym = loc.get("symbolic", {})
            concrete = loc.get("concrete", {})
            key = sym.get("key", {})
            local = key.get("Local", {})
            path = local.get("given_path", "<stdin>" if "Stdin" in key else "")
            point = concrete.get("location", {})
            start, end = point.get("start_point", {}), point.get("end_point", {})
            row, col = start.get("row", 0), start.get("column", 0)
            feature = concrete.get("feature", "")
            source = sources.get(path, "")
            source_lines = source.splitlines()
            end_row, end_col = end.get("row", row), end.get("column", col + 1)
            if end_col == 0 and end_row > row:
                end_row -= 1
                end_col = len(source_lines[end_row]) if end_row < len(source_lines) else 0
            lines_out.append(f" --> {path}:{row + 1}:{col + 1}")
            lines_out.append("  |")
            if source_lines and row < len(source_lines):
                first_row = row
                last_row = min(end_row, len(source_lines) - 1)
                width = len(str(last_row + 1))
                for line_no in range(first_row, last_row + 1):
                    source_line = source_lines[line_no]
                    lines_out.append(f"{line_no + 1:>{width}} | {source_line}")
                    if line_no == first_row and line_no == last_row:
                        length = max(1, end_col - col)
                        marker = " " * col + "^" * length
                        annotation = sym.get("annotation", "")
                        lines_out.append(f"{'':>{width}} | {marker} {annotation}".rstrip())
            elif feature:
                lines_out.append(f"{row + 1} | {feature.rstrip()}")
                lines_out.append(f"  | {' ' * col}^{' ' + sym.get('annotation', '')}")
            lines_out.append("  |")
        lines_out.append(f"  = note: audit confidence → {det.get('confidence', 'High')}")
        if ident in ("artipacked", "template-injection", "dangerous-triggers"):
            lines_out.append("  = note: this finding has an auto-fix")
        if show_urls:
            lines_out.append(f"  = help: audit documentation → {item.get('url', '')}")
        lines_out.append("")
    counts = {k: sum(str(f.get("determinations", {}).get("severity", "")).lower() == k
                     for f in findings) for k in ("informational", "low", "medium", "high")}
    fixes = (sum(f.get("ident") in ("artipacked", "template-injection") for f in findings)
             if unsafe_fixes is None else unsafe_fixes)
    total = len(findings) + suppressed
    details = []
    if suppressed:
        details.append(f"{suppressed} suppressed")
    if fixes:
        details.append(f"{fixes} unsafe fixes")
    note = f" ({', '.join(details)})" if details else ""
    lines_out.append(f"{total} findings{note}: {counts['informational']} informational, "
                     f"{counts['low']} low, {counts['medium']} medium, {counts['high']} high")
    return "\n".join(lines_out) + "\n"
